components.heading: Suspension or revocation – Written notice required.
components.text: Written notice of suspension or revocation of a license under this title stating the cause or causes therefor shall be delivered to the licensee personally or mailed to the licensee’s address as stated in the licensee’s application for a license. (Code 1981 § 24-11. Code 1995 § 30-36.)
